terra.problem: The imagined reaction of everybody in the camp adds an event the text does not describe. Marking it as a guess does not establish that it happened.
Telling the baker not to add things to the dough scolds them for their answer.
The passage does not say he never runs or establish that he is still in the camp when he is brought to Moses.
Shelomith is not the only named family member. The passage also names her father, Dibri.
The passage does not say whether anyone guesses or votes while they wait.
Calling the statement a trap comments on the question itself. The parenthetical also brings an irrelevant incorrect reference and a self-correction into the explanation.
